title: The House of Vessel Farm
author: X. M. Underhill
blurb: Odile Thackeray, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
